Your story, in three steps.

Visit the help page
01

Open the camera

Launch on a compatible iPhone and allow Camera, Microphone and Add to Photos when prompted.

02

Arrange both views

Choose Photo or Video. Move or resize the floating window, or swap the main camera.

03

Capture, save, share

Tap to capture, or tap again to stop video. After processing, your capture saves automatically. Share it from preview.
